grades.quote: an ECALL by a user-mode hart will generally result in a transfer of control to a supervisor-mode handler running on the same hart.
grades.reason: The passage names ECALL as the instruction that, when run by a user-mode hart, transfers control to a supervisor-mode handler on the same hart. This is the mechanism the query asks about. It does not use the words 'OS service request', but a supervisor-mode handler is the OS-level handler.
